title: Unify the game UI and establish reusable templates
outcome: From the cinematic title through colony management, players use one readable gothic-industrial interface with predictable controls and state feedback.
scope: Shared Unity uGUI theme tokens, type hierarchy, spacing, semantic colors, and accessible control states
Reusable UI components and layouts for screens, HUD bars, panels, dialogs, tooltips, toasts, and the Vox portrait card

Migrate the current non-Urban player UI surfaces: title, setup, landing, HUD, build and placement, inspectors and ship, industry, resources and surveys, research, guide, mining, earthworks, events, and save/load feedback
Reconcile the local-only cinematic menu and save browser with existing save schema and migration behavior
nonGoals: Change gameplay rules, bindings, camera behavior, save data, or Unity rendering pipeline
Implement or migrate Urban development UI/runtime; track in follow-up issue #29
Claim broad long-copy/populated-state coverage across all panels; track in follow-up issue #30
Replace the cinematic world backdrop or copy official game UI assets
Redesign editor and developer diagnostics as player UI
acceptance: A title → new game → landing → build → inspect → save → load playthrough keeps existing actions, values and states, including loading a GUID-named disposable save through the visible browser
All in-scope non-Urban screens use the documented theme and shared components, including enabled, focused, disabled, warning and critical states
Representative screens are visually reviewed at 1280×800, 1920×1080, and 2560×890; survey and event long-copy examples fit, and the Vox/ship layout is clear
A documented template example and guard catch new hardcoded shared style values and ad hoc controls outside agreed exceptions
The portrait-card template displays a character, role, priority, message and optional action without taking game input
rollback: Split template and screen migration into reviewable pull requests. Revert a migration slice while its legacy UI remains available. Preserve scene and asset GUIDs.
